instruction: Grab a screenshot of the paused video and save it with filename 'frame_capture.png' on Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to frame_capture.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/frame_capture.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts file metadata including existence, PNG magic bytes validation, file size, and image dimensions
Metric properly validates all critical aspects: file exists, is valid PNG (magic bytes check), has reasonable file size (>=1KB), and has valid dimensions (width>0, height>0)
Evaluator can distinguish between legitimate PNG screenshots and fake attempts (empty files created with 'touch', renamed text files, corrupted images)
Complete coverage: The instruction requires saving a screenshot as PNG, and the evaluator verifies file format, size, and validity
Logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime: uses bash commands to check file, PNG magic bytes via xxd, and ImageMagick identify for dimensions
Addresses all previous concerns: validates PNG format, checks file size to prevent empty files, validates image dimensions
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add upper bound file size check to detect anomalies (e.g., file_size < 50MB), but not critical for this use case
